scope: exact toy-size counts; research/odd_n_trace_accounting_20261107 run-20261107T1; no ECDLP cost, no solver cost
statement: Odd-n trace accounting at toy sizes (E: y^2+xy=x^3+ax^2+b over F_{2^N}, N=dn; n=3,5 with d=3,4,5 and the n=4 control with d=3,4; 4 curves per cell): exact counts N(R) of ordered n-decompositions over F_q-line factor bases. Exact checks: 2E criterion vs [#E/2]R=O 0 mismatches; MITM vs brute force 0 mismatches on 2,293,041 (arm,target) pairs; coset identity sum_{2E}N=((m0+m1)^n+(m0-m1)^n)/2 exact on 120 census arm-units; 0 of 469,256 off-2E counts nonzero for trace-homogeneous arms at odd n. On 2E targets the pooled size-normalised ratio kappa_tw/kappa_std is 1.96 for odd n and 0.996 for n=4. Registered verdicts: P2, P4, P7, P8 PASS; P1, P3, P5, P6 FAIL (zero means and degenerate units at n=5); interpretation rule inconclusive. Post hoc pooling (labelled, in posthoc.txt, not recomputed by the validator): a matched-size trace-homogeneous ordinary line hz gets the same factor (kappa_hz/kappa_std 2.08 [1.62,2.72] on 2E; kappa_tw/kappa_hz 0.90 [0.71,1.11]).
